subject: Forest Seal
text: Destroying all six spheres in the Keep removes the barrier in the middle of the Keep, granting access to Ganon's Tower.

evidence.quote: Destroying all six spheres in the Keep will remove the barrier in the middle of the Keep, letting you enter Ganon's Tower.

subject: Forest Seal
text: Shooting the Forest Seal barrier with a Light Arrow causes Saria to appear and send you back to the Keep.

evidence.quote: Shoot the barrier with a Light Arrow, and Saria will appear.  She will send you back to the Keep.

subject: Water Seal Door
text: Heading right down the stairs from the Forest Seal hallway leads to a door inscribed with the Water Medallion.

evidence.quote: Head to the right as you come out of the Forest Seal hallway, and go right down the stairs.  At the bottom is a door inscribed with the Water Medallion.

subject: Freezzard
text: Fire Arrows work quite well to defeat the two Freezzards in Water Seal Room One.

evidence.quote: Two Freezzards will also appear.  Kill both of the Freezzards (Fire Arrows work quite well), and the door behind the wall of ice will unseal itself.

subject: Blue Fire
text: Blue Fire in the center of Water Seal Room One can be captured in an empty bottle and used to melt the sheet of ice blocking the door.

evidence.quote: Capture some of the Blue Fire in the center of the room in an empty bottle, and then use it to melt the sheet of ice blocking the door.

subject: Water Seal Room Two Block Puzzle
text: In Water Seal Room Two, there is a two-minute time limit to complete the ice block puzzle.

evidence.quote: In this room, you have two minutes to finish a block-pushing puzzle similar to the one you solved previously in the Ice Cavern.

subject: Water Seal Room Two Block Puzzle
text: To solve the puzzle, push the rear ice block right against a rock, then forward into a pit; next, push the remaining ice block forward across the pit, forward again from the door side, and forward to the opposite wall.

evidence.quote: There are two ice blocks in the room; run to the left side of the rear block, and push it to the right so that it collides with a rock in the ground.  Then go to the left side of the block, and push it forward so it lands in a pit in the front of the room.  Now, go to the remaining Ice Block, go to it's right side and push it forward, so that it slides across the pit you just filled in with the other block.  Go to the block's right side again (the side closest to the door you came through), and push the block forward.  Now go around to the side of the block closest to the right wall, and push it forward to the opposite wall.

subject: Rusted Switch
text: Melt the ice on the ledge with Blue Fire and hit the rusted switch with the Megaton Hammer to unseal the rear door in Water Seal Room Two.

evidence.quote: Use your bottle of Blue Fire to melt the ice.  Press down the rusted switching using the Megaton Hammer to unseal the door in the rear of the room.

subject: Water Seal
text: Dispelling the Water Seal orb with Light Arrows causes Princess Ruto to appear and transport you back to the Keep.

evidence.quote: Shoot the orb with the Light Arrows to dispel it.  Ruto will appear, and transport you back to the Keep.

subject: Shadow Seal Door
text: Going right up the stairs in the Keep leads to the door emblazoned with the Shadow Medallion.

evidence.quote: Go right up the stairs, and through the door emblazoned with the Shadow Medallion.

subject: Shadow Seal Room One Chest
text: The chest to the left in Shadow Seal Room One contains a Blue Rupee and can be reached using the Longshot or by playing the Song of Time to make three Blocks of Time appear and using the Hover Boots.

evidence.quote: Look to the left as you enter the room, and you'll see a chest.  Use the Longshot to pull yourself over to the chest.  Alternatively, you can also use the Song of Time to make three Blocks of Time appear, where you can then reach the chest with the Hover Boots.  The chest contains a Blue Rupee.

subject: Unlit Torch
text: Lighting the unlit torch with a Fire Arrow causes a series of temporary platforms to appear towards the back of the room.

evidence.quote: Turn around from the chest to see an unlit torch.  Light it with a Fire Arrow, and a series of platforms will temporarily appear.

subject: Shadow Seal Room One Chest
text: Stepping onto the switch on the opaque platforms before time runs out makes a chest containing the Gold Gauntlets appear on the previous ledge.

evidence.quote: Quickly run down them and step onto the switch before time runs out and the platforms disappear again... A chest will appear back on the previous ledge; go to it and open it to get the Gold Gauntlets.

subject: Gold Gauntlets
text: The Gold Gauntlets allow you to pick up and hurl aside various Black Obelisks found inside and outside Ganon's Castle.

evidence.quote: With these, you can hurl aside the various Black Obelisks that appear both inside and outside Ganon's Castle

subject: Rusty Switch
text: Following an invisible path with the Lens of Truth and smashing the rusty switch with the Megaton Hammer unseals the back door in Shadow Seal Room One.

evidence.quote: Look to the left side of the room from this platform, and use the Lens of Truth to see an invisible path.  Follow it to the rusty switch.  Smash it with the Megaton Hammer to activate it.  The door in the back of the room will unseal it.

subject: Shadow Seal
text: Destroying the Shadow Seal with a Light Arrow makes Impa appear to return you to the Keep.

evidence.quote: Destroy the seal with a Light Arrow, and Impa will appear to return you to the Keep.

subject: Fairy Fountain
text: Across the bridge of light outside Ganon's Castle, lifting and hurling aside the black obelisk with the Gold Gauntlets at the end of the small canyon reveals a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: Head back across the bridge of light, and go left under the arch on the other side.  Climb over the rubble here and go to the end of the small canyon.  With the Gold Gauntlets, you can pick up the black obelisk here and hurl it aside, revealing a Fairy Fountain

subject: Great Fairy
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce Symbol summons the Great Fairy, who enhances your defenses, doubling your health and giving heart containers a white border.

evidence.quote: Run forward and stand on the Triforce Symbol, and play Zelda's Lullaby to make the Great Fairy appear... She'll enhance your defenses - in essence, doubling your health.  Notice how your heart containers now have a white border.

subject: Fire Seal Door
text: The door emblazoned with the Fire Medallion is located in the Keep past the Shadow Seal.

evidence.quote: Enter the door emblazoned with the Fire Medallion past the Shadow Seal.

subject: Fire Seal Room One
text: Completing Fire Seal Room One requires the Gold Gauntlets and wearing the Goron Tunic to survive the room's heat.

evidence.quote: You can't complete this Seal without the Gold Gauntlets... Equip your Goron Tunic as you enter to survive the heat of the room.

subject: Fire Seal Room One Silver Rupees
text: Collecting all five Silver Rupees across the sinking platforms, rotating flames ledge, under the black obelisk, on the Fire Slug platform, and across the makeshift pillar bridge unseals the rear door.

evidence.quote: Jump out to the platform and grab the Silver Rupee... Follow the path of the flames around to the rear of the platform, and take the second Silver Rupee... Climb up to the black obelisk, and with the Gold Gauntlets you can throw it aside, where it will land across the room.  Take the Silver Rupee that was underneath the pillar... Kill the Fire Slug, and take the Silver Rupee.  The pillar you tossed aside earlier is now forming a makeshift bridge to the last Silver Rupee.  Jump out to the pillar, and then to the last Silver Rupee.  The door in the rear of the room will now unseal itself.

subject: Fire Seal Room One Rear Door
text: Using the Longshot on the target to the right of the unsealed door pulls you over to reach the exit.

evidence.quote: Look towards the back of the room, and use the Longshot on the target to the right of the now-unsealed door to pull yourself over to it.  Go through the door.

subject: Fire Seal
text: Destroying the Fire Seal with a Light Arrow summons Darunia, who returns you to the Keep.

evidence.quote: Destroy the Seal with a Light Arrow, and Darunia will appear to send you back to the Keep.

subject: Light Seal Door
text: At the bottom of the stairs to the right of the Fire Seal door, throwing aside a black obelisk reveals the door inscribed with the Light Medallion.

evidence.quote: At the bottom of the stairs, there is another black obelisk.  Throw it aside, where it will shatter against the shield guarding Ganon's Tower.  The door behind the black obelisk is inscribed with the Light Medallion.  Go through it.

subject: Light Seal Room One Chest
text: Defeating the invisible Big Skulltula and four invisible Keese using the Lens of Truth makes a chest containing a Small Key appear in the middle of Light Seal Room One.

evidence.quote: This room is full of invisible enemies; namely, a Big Skulltula and four invisible Keese.  Use the Lens of Truth to find and kill them all, then open the chest that appears in the middle of the room to get a Small Key.

subject: Light Seal Room Two Chest
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol makes a chest appear with a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Stand on the triforce symbol and play Zelda's Lullaby.  Open the chest that appears to get a Small Key.

subject: Light Seal Room Three Silver Rupees
text: Within a one-minute time limit, Longshot to the ceiling target above the central pillar and collect all five Silver Rupees from the alcoves and pillar area to unseal the exit door.

evidence.quote: Time Limit: 1:00... Look on the ceiling above the pillar to see a Longshot target.  Pull yourself up to it using the Longshot.  When you land, you will get the first Silver Rupee... Look to the left of the sealed door on the other side of the room, where you will find a small alcove with the second Silver Rupee... From this alcove, run back towards the pillar in the center of the room and into the alcove beside it to get another Silver Rupee.  Head around to the opposite side of the pillar, where you will find two more identically placed Silver Rupees; one in alcove, another near the pillar.  Once you get all five of the rupees, then the sealed door will unseal itself.
